facts.business: SWELECT Energy Systems Limited is a renewable energy company providing integrated energy solutions including solar, wind, energy storage systems (BESS), IPP, EPC, and channel-driven products for residential, commercial, industrial, and utility customers.

segments.name: Channel-driven products for residential and commercial customers (including home energy and BESS)

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Evaluation of impairment of investments in three operating subsidiaries with accumulated losses (Investments net of impairment: Rs. 5,891.91 lakhs; impairment amount: Rs. 3,467.38 lakhs).

key_risks: Impairment risk on investments in subsidiaries with accumulated losses
Dependence on management judgment for valuation assumptions (discount rate, growth rate, forecasted revenue)
Regulatory and tax disputes (Commercial Taxes, Central Excise, VAT)
